How we work

A clear process — from conversation to delivery.

No hidden costs, no unnecessary bureaucracy. We adapt to you.

Private client

How we start — house, interiors, renovation.

B2B client

How we start — 3D, documentation, CGI.

01

Brief & materials

You send us a brief and available materials: sketches, drawings, 3D model, geometry description — or a point cloud from a laser scan.

02

FAQ

Frequently asked questions — private clients.

How long does a project take?

A concept design typically takes 2–4 weeks. Full building documentation — from 2 to 6 months depending on the scale.

What do I need to prepare for the first meeting?

Just a general idea and information about the plot or location. If you have a map, plan or reference images — bring them along.

Do you handle planning permissions?

Yes. We prepare documentation for building authorities and can represent the client in the administrative process.

Can I commission just an interior design without architecture?

Yes. We carry out interior design projects independently — from concept to full construction documentation.

Remote precision

We work from point clouds — no site visit required.

Many of the architecture firms that commission us work on buildings in the UK, USA or other countries. In these cases we often receive the project as a point cloud — a digital representation of the space obtained through laser scanning (LiDAR).

From the point cloud we create a precise 3D model or documentation without needing a site visit. The building geometry — every angle, every deviation from vertical, every detail — is encoded in the scan data to within a few millimetres.

This means the project is highly accurate — often more accurate than a traditional manual survey — and we can start work immediately upon receiving the file, regardless of distance.

—

Input formats

.pts, .e57, .las, .xyz, .rcp — we handle all common point cloud formats.

—

Software

Rhino3D + PointCloud plugin, Autodesk ReCap, CloudCompare — full workflow from raw scan to model.

—

Accuracy

Laser scanning achieves accuracy of 2–5 mm — this translates directly into the quality of construction documentation.

—

Remote = efficient

No site visit means lower cost and a faster project start — without compromising quality.

FAQ

Frequently asked questions — B2B clients.

What is the minimum project value?

There is no formal minimum. We take on both small commissions (a steel element, an ornament) and multi-month collaborations.

Can we work remotely?

Yes. Most of our B2B clients are firms from the UK and USA. Communication via email, Zoom and file-sharing platforms.

What if the documentation changes mid-project?

We adapt. We work in iterations — changes to documentation are a standard part of the process.

What software do you use?

Rhino 3D, Grasshopper, ArchiCAD (BIM), AutoCAD, Unreal Engine 5, Photoshop.

Ready to start?

Send us a brief or just a short description of your project — we'll take it from there.
